versions.content: If the ComM calls Nm_PassiveStartUp () for a network that is part of a coordinated cluster of networks, the Nm coordinator functionality shall treat this call as if the ComM had called Nm_NetworkRequest (). In case BusNmType is not set to NM_BUSNM_LOCALNM the Nm shall forward a call of <BusNm>_NetworkRe- quest to the lower layer and accordingly, the network shall be counted as requested by the NM coordinator.
